# captured by capri

> captured by capri is a photography business run by Capri in Utah County, Utah. Capri photographs senior portraits, individuals, couples, families, branding and school dance groups at outdoor locations anywhere in Utah County (lakeshores, open fields and mountains). Sessions start at $75 and photos are delivered within 1 to 2 weeks. Booking is through the website's inquiry form or Instagram @captured.by.capri.

## Sessions and pricing (updated November 2026)

- Individual & Senior session: $75, 60+ photos
- Couple session: $90, 70+ photos
- Family session: $105, 65+ photos
- Branding session: $115, 75+ photos
- School dance group: from $15, depends on the number of couples
- Custom sessions: custom quote
- A travel fee is added for locations farther away within Utah County
